data.fund_name: Baroda BNP Paribas Banking and Financial Services Fund
data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme investing in the Banking and Financial Services sector
data.investment_objective: The investment objective is to generate long term capital appreciation for unit holders from a portfolio invested predominantly in equity and equity related securities of companies engaged in the Banking & Financial Services Sector.
data.asset_allocation: Equity & Equity related securities of companies engaged in Banking & Financial Services Sector 80% - 100% Equity & Equity related securities of companies engaged in Non Banking & Financial Services Sector 0% - 20% Debt and Money Market Instruments 0% - 20% Investment in REITs and InvITs 0% - 10%
data.fund_managers: Mr. Sanjay Chawla and Mr. Yash Mehta
data.exit_load: • If units of the Scheme are redeemed or switched out within 30 days of the date of allotment - 1% of the applicable Net Asset Value (NAV) • If units of the Scheme are redeemed or switched out after 30 days of allotment - Nil
